objective: Audit the proposed proof in draft.md. Establish whether its theorem is true, identify the decisive inference, and deliver a corrected result or an explicit obstruction. Do not silently change the hypotheses.

files.draft.md: Claim: Every subadditive function f on the positive integers with f(1)=1 satisfies f(n)<n for all n>1. Proposed proof: by induction, f(n+1)<=f(n)+f(1)<n+1. The base n=2 is clear by subadditivity.
